| RedCap / IoT module post-silicon regression | Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester with post-silicon workflow。[72] | 快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。[72] | 未提供 RTD version、MT8000A catalog version 或完整 timing / synchronization requirements。[73][74] |

【推論】If the sales target is cellular / NTN modem validation, CMX500 should be positioned around NR‑NTN / NB‑NTN / D2C and Rel.17 conformance readiness, because the passages connect CMX500 to NTN network/device-level testing and separately cite Samsung latest NR‑NTN chipset validation in RF / RRM / PCT domains.[18][45]

| NTN modem / chipset validation | R&S CMX500 NTN one-box tester。[45] | 切入 NR‑NTN、NB‑NTN、Direct-to-Cell network and device level testing，以及 Doppler、delay、path loss、orbit / frequency-band emulation challenges。[43][45] | NTN PR 未提供 formal configuration、software option stack、measurement specification 或 order number。[45] |
| NR‑NTN conformance / carrier acceptance readiness | R&S CMX500 / R&S conformance ecosystem。[18][44] | R&S claims leading Rel.17 NTN conformance and highest number of GCF validated 3GPP NR NTN RF / RRM / PCT test cases, including verification of Samsung latest NR‑NTN chipset at CAG #86。[18] | 來源未提供 test case IDs、underlying GCF dataset、validation body minutes、test specification version or Samsung validation report。[44][82] |
| FR2 / mmWave radiated validation | R&S CMX500 + CMXHEAD30 / CMXHEAD50 / CMXHEAD50-Evo + CMQ500 or ATS800R。[2] | Remote radio head split concept supports short RF cables and optimized link budget in FR2 radiated chamber environments。[2] | Passage does not provide formal BOM, RF chain count, calibration details, DUT conditions or semiconductor-specific account fit。[2] |
| Full cellular + WLAN OTA signaling workflow | R&S CMX500 OBT integrated with MVG WaveStudio or EMITE OTA chambers。[98][34] | MVG integration supports 5G NR、RedCap、LTE、WLAN OTA signaling tests, and later adds full WLAN signaling including Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be。[98] | MVG and EMITE sources do not list chamber models, option codes, CSW version, RF chains, complete test case list, pass/fail criteria or measurement uncertainty。[35][38] |
### 限制
Several strong R&S claims are PR / solution-positioning level rather than formal datasheet, configuration guide, certification document, or validation report, especially Wi‑Fi 7 / Wi‑Fi 8 and NTN demonstration claims [75][27][44]。
MediaTek M80 evidence is roadmap / market-presentation level and not an official MediaTek datasheet, release support matrix, commercial availability proof, certification status, or production confirmation [86]。
Project Kuiper evidence describes user terminal test / supply-chain flows, but it cannot be used to infer actual service launch, satellite count, terminal shipments, supplier contracts, or R&S relationship [87]。
【推論】If the sales target is semiconductor protocol teams before tape-out, the cleanest evidence-backed opening is Virtual Signalling Tester because the passage directly says chipset development, pre-silicon, virtual terminal protocol test, Shift-Left, and reduced rework.[70]
【推論】If the sales target is WLAN chipset or module validation across R&D and production, the strongest product split supported by current evidence is CMX500 for Wi‑Fi 7 / Wi‑Fi 8 signaling R&D and CMP180 for Wi‑Fi 7 production non-signaling RF, because the passages explicitly separate CMX500 R&D signaling from CMP180 production non-signaling.[10][11][12][25]
【推論】If the sales target is cellular / NTN modem validation, CMX500 should be positioned around NR‑NTN / NB‑NTN / D2C and Rel.17 conformance readiness, because the passages connect CMX500 to NTN network/device-level testing and separately cite Samsung latest NR‑NTN chipset validation in RF / RRM / PCT domains.[18][45]

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 與 Virtual tester 的區分
[[Virtual tester]] 在 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 中是 R&S AI Workplace questionnaire 的 agentic workflow concept，跨 implementation、test、debug、validation。

[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 則是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu NR / RedCap protocol simulation and test product / solution 語彙。兩者名稱相近，但目前沒有來源支持它們是同一產品、同一架構或同一市場分類。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Interface 類型
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 列出三種 Virtual Signalling Tester interface / configuration：

| Interface | 來源描述 | 相關 items |
|---|---|---|
| [[MAC-IF]] | MAC-IF for NR/RedCap | [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、MX844030PC-PL011、MX844030PC-PL012 |
| [[PHY-IF]] / [[Digital IQ]] | PHY-IF Digital-IQ for RedCap；non real-time | [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、MX844030PC-PL001 |
| [[RF-IF]] | RF-IF for RedCap；real-time with Anritsu SDR Unit | [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]]、[[MX819020A]] |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant
[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中介紹的 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester AI-powered scripting tool，使用 generative AI 與 natural language processing 協助測試工程師生成、擴充與理解 [[XLAPI]] scripts。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]]，[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 是為 [[R&S CMX500]] 開發的 AI-driven scripting support solution。來源將它定位為可 automate test script generation and functional testing 的工具，目標是協助 mobile device manufacturers 的 test engineers：

- streamline workflows；
- reduce the risk of errors；
- speed up time-to-market；
- 以 tailored and efficient approach automating domain-specific applications。

來源中的 domain-specific applications 包含：

- R&D [[5G NR]] protocol testing；
- application testing；
- CMX instrument automation；
- many more（來源未展開）。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant › Script generation inputs
來源描述測試工程師手動產生 test scripts 時，常需從多個來源彙整輸入。來源明示的來源類型包括：

- [[3GPP specifications]]；
- [[XLAPI]] scripts；
- [[Python]]；
- [[R&S CMX500]] user manual。

[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 被描述為用來緩解這種 multi-source script generation challenge 的新 solution。

Q2_2026 Conformance & NetOp Updates_Customer
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 1CD3 Product Management Team 的 Q2 / 2026 company restricted Conformance & NetOp update 簡報，涵蓋 market / operator news、[[GCF]] / [[PTCRB]] / [[CTIA]] 更新、[[R&S CONTEST]]、RF / RRM / PCT、NetOp 與 LBS product highlights。

本次來源位於 `raw/Knowledge/`，因此以 [[Knowledge 類資料]] 入口保存其對 conformance、NetOp、LBS、CONTEST 與測試方案 roadmap 的技術 / 標準化脈絡；但內容同時包含 operator roadmap、certification landscape 與 validation status，閱讀時也應連到 [[Market 類資料]] 的時間敏感限制。來源正文只標示 Q2 / 2026，未標示完整發布日；raw converted date 為 2026-09-24。

Q2_2026 Conformance & NetOp Updates_Customer › 關鍵實體與概念
- 實體：[[Rohde & Schwarz]]、[[TCCA]]、[[GCF]]、[[PTCRB]]、[[CTIA]]、[[Keysight]]、[[Anritsu]]、[[Spirent]]、[[Starlink]]、[[Skylo]]、[[Viasat]]、[[AST]]、[[T-Mobile]]、[[AT&T]]、[[Verizon]]、[[Boost]]、[[Charter]]、[[Comcast]]、[[Samsung]]、[[R&S CONTEST]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]、[[R&S TS-RRM]]、[[R&S TS8991]]、[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]]。

Q2_2026 Conformance & NetOp Updates_Customer › 重點摘要
- [[SG #106 takeaways Q2 2026]]：new work items focus on [[Mission Critical Services]]、Rel-18 IDC NR/MR-DC、Rel-18 IoT NTN enhancements、Rel-17 NR UDC、MCS IOP Testing 與 IoT-focused Cybersecurity Work Stream。
- [[PTCRB RFT559 eRedCap]]：來源說 RFT559 eRedCap 只是 number defined aligned to GCF WI number，expected to be filled within next meetings。
- [[CTIA OTA Test Plan v9.0]]：來源列出 upcoming OTA Test Plan v9.0，tech contributions / approval deadline March 2026，first publication possibly June 2026 / Q4 2026，mandatory 至少 after v8.0.x mandatory 6 months；重點包含 NR FR1 / LTE / NTN、NB-IoT NTN normative、NR FR1 NTN、FR2 charging cable / phantom / RB allocation、A-GNSS test time reduction、6–7 GHz band inclusions。
- [[CONTEST Report Manager and Data Cloud]]：來源列出 [[TS8-KT101]] new report manager & storage、[[TS8-KT116]] new data cloud，包含 [[CORC]] data framework、result server、browser-based Report Manager、Live System Monitor、central storage 與 flexible hosting options。

- [[RF RRM conformance outlook Q2 2026]]：來源在 TP 298 / 296 段落說 R&S together with KS leading platform for 5G、only platform to support 2G–5G、leading in Rel.17 NTN conformance，並引用即將發布 PR：R&S achieves highest number of GCF validated 3GPP NR NTN test cases for RF, RRM and PCT domains at [[CAG #86]] verifying latest NR-NTN chipset from [[Samsung]]。

MediaTek M80 › 來源中的說法
[[oneweb_ut_final_presentation]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）對 [[MediaTek M80]] 的描述包含：

- 在 laboratory RF test 階段，modulation / coding analysis 寫 OneWeb proprietary 或 [[MediaTek M80]] 5G NTN modem。
- 在 field link validation 階段，寫 5G NTN trial 啟動：[[Sharp]] + [[MediaTek M80]] modem。
- 在 multi-OEM terminal ecosystem 中，[[Sharp]] 5G NTN LEO terminal 被描述為使用 [[MediaTek M80]] 5G modem，status 為 2025 trial stage。
- RF components & semiconductor supplier tier 中寫 [[MediaTek M80]] 5G NTN 支援 [[3GPP Release 19]]，用於 Sharp trial，是 5G convergence key。
- Taiwan strategy positioning 中將 [[MediaTek]] 描述為 5G NTN modem supplier with strategic position，並與 [[Sharp]]、[[工研院]] 合作同列。
- 5G NTN strategic roadmap 中列出：[[3GPP Release 19]]、[[MediaTek M80]] 5G NR-NTN modem、ITRI satellite-board gNB、Ericsson / Nokia 3GPP certification。
- Commercial milestones 中列出 `2025 H1: Sharp 5G NTN trial validation`、`2025 H2: MediaTek commercial modem mass production`、`2026+: global 5G NTN service coverage`。

MediaTek M80 › 與既有 MediaTek / NTN 頁面的關係
- [[MediaTek]] 既有頁面已整理 [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 的 [[3GPP Release 17]] NTN-NR demo 語境。
- 本頁新增的是 [[oneweb_ut_final_presentation]] 的 [[3GPP Release 19]] / [[Sharp]] trial / [[MediaTek M80]] roadmap 語境。
- 兩者層級不同：前者是 PR demo；本頁來源是 OneWeb UT presentation / market roadmap，尚非官方 product specification。

MediaTek M80 › unresolved
- 需要取得 [[MediaTek]] 官方 [[MediaTek M80]] datasheet、press release 或 product page。
- 需要確認 [[MediaTek M80]] 是否正式支援 [[3GPP Release 19]] NTN，以及支援範圍是 modem、protocol stack、RF、NB-NTN、NR-NTN 或其他。
- 需要確認 [[Sharp]] trial 的日期、終端型號、衛星 operator、frequency band、test setup 與結果。
- 需要確認 `2025 H2` commercial modem mass production 是否為已發生事件、計畫或簡報假設。

Project Kuiper › 測試與產品化流程
來源把 [[Kuiper UT 測試流程]]分成：

- 製造階段：工廠驗收測試 FAT、射頻模式驗證、熱電性能。
- 系統整合：實驗室端對端測試、協議棧驗證、模擬器模擬。
- 現場驗證：Protoflight 試驗、真實衛星測試、1000+ 終端試驗。

來源列出的時間點包括 2023 Protoflight、2024 1000+ 單位測試、2025 實衛星速率、2026 Q1 商用化準備；但未提供外部公告或測試報告。

Project Kuiper
[[Project Kuiper]] 是 [[Amazon]] 的低軌衛星通訊 / user terminal 相關計畫名稱，本 vault 目前由 [[Kuiper UT Test & Supply Chain]] 提供其用戶終端測試流程、產品化準備與供應鏈策略的 company restricted 簡報說法。

Project Kuiper › 來源中的商業目標
[[Kuiper UT Test & Supply Chain]]（來源正文未標示正式發布日期；raw converted 2026-09-17）稱：

- 2026年Q1：在美、加、英、德、法 5 個國家上線服務。
- 2026 年底：覆蓋範圍擴展至 26 個國家。
- 市場客群：住宅、企業、政府、電信回傳。
- 產品定位：競爭光纖價格，超越現有衛星服務。
- 2026年Q1 部署時間表另稱 5 國上線時衛星數為 200+ 顆。
- 成功關鍵因素列有預計 3200+ LEO 衛星、全球涵蓋競爭力、AWS 整合與低成本製造。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 來源中的測試情境
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 final IEEE standard ratification 前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8]] RF tests in signaling mode 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 測試展示使用 [[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device。
- 展示地點為 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可 showcase physical layer features unique to [[Wi-Fi 8]]。
- 來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，以及 future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 與 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試的區分
本頁不同於 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 目前由 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR 支撐，聚焦 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] over-the-air chamber workflow。
- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。
- 本來源未說明 OTA chamber、reverberation chamber、anechoic chamber、antenna performance 或 MIMO stress testing setup。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 支撐。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 來源中的測試架構
依 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可與 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 latest sophisticated testing features combined。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- cellular technologies：[[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz、latest [[5G RedCap]]。
- non-cellular technologies：latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- integration enables support of LTE、FR1、FR2、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- EMITE customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] and [[5G RedCap]] devices。

- 來源未標示發布日期。

- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full WLAN signaling test functionality，包括 [[Wi-Fi 7]]，整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。

- 來源連回前一份合作背景新聞稿 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]。
- [[MVG]] 公司背景段落與前一份來源一致：提供 electromagnetic waves visualization、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 方案；營運於 10 個國家；90% sales from exports；Group revenues exceeding €100 million。

### 限制
Several strong R&S claims are PR / solution-positioning level rather than formal datasheet, configuration guide, certification document, or validation report, especially Wi‑Fi 7 / Wi‑Fi 8 and NTN demonstration claims [75][27][44]。
MediaTek M80 evidence is roadmap / market-presentation level and not an official MediaTek datasheet, release support matrix, commercial availability proof, certification status, or production confirmation [86]。
Project Kuiper evidence describes user terminal test / supply-chain flows, but it cannot be used to infer actual service launch, satellite count, terminal shipments, supplier contracts, or R&S relationship [87]。
【推論】If the sales target is semiconductor protocol teams before tape-out, the cleanest evidence-backed opening is Virtual Signalling Tester because the passage directly says chipset development, pre-silicon, virtual terminal protocol test, Shift-Left, and reduced rework.[70]

【推論】If the sales target is cellular / NTN modem validation, CMX500 should be positioned around NR‑NTN / NB‑NTN / D2C and Rel.17 conformance readiness, because the passages connect CMX500 to NTN network/device-level testing and separately cite Samsung latest NR‑NTN chipset validation in RF / RRM / PCT domains.[18][45]
